descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S03 「养老院在 Today's Visits 和 All Residents 里按姓名、单元/房间和 MRN 搜索」 Nursing Home search by name, unit/room and MRN in Today's Visits and All Residents

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 3；TFA-92581 AC 6）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given One resident whose name, unit or MRN holds a unique token; on today's list (today tests) or only in All Residents (all tests)

When Type part of the token, then a no-match string, then Clear search

Then The resident is found by each field in both views; the no-match string lists nobody; Clear restores the list

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions as in S01 (U4 name, unit/room, MRN). No existing test covers facility (S10). The 'Nursing Home today/all: search independently by diagnosis' tests are left out on purpose: they assert NH diagnosis IS searchable, the opposite of AC 3 (see S07). Needs precondition P1

在哪跑：dev 上的 datasets（种数据集跑列表）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S03 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev，lane datasets（datasets/results.json，截图不附）。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev/datasets。
